canonical_setup: Standard 52-card deck; 7 cards each for 2-3 players or 5 each for 4-5 players; remaining cards form stock
core_loop: Ask one player for a rank already held; successful requests continue; otherwise draw; collect four-card books
rank_suit_load: Recognize and name ranks; suits do not matter
rule_variant_to_freeze: Use Bicycle four-card-book version and its stock/deal rules
rescue_or_adjustment_to_test: Test a smaller rank set and a card holder when seven-card hands are unwieldy; do not publish as easier until observed
architecture_verdict: Lead candidate: distinct asking and collecting hook; family fit and smaller-deck rescue require observation
evidence_classification: Setup, rules, players, and publisher age are SOURCE_BACKED; rescue and architecture are EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT; KAL outcomes are UNKNOWN

canonical_setup: Standard deck with one queen removed; deal all 51 cards; discard pairs before drawing from the next player's hidden hand
core_loop: Draw one hidden card from a neighbor; discard pairs; one unmatched queen remains
rank_suit_load: Match equal ranks; hold and fan a potentially large hand
pace_or_contact: Turn-based; one named loser can create frustration
rule_variant_to_freeze: Use Bicycle's one-queen-removed version; label the odd card neutrally in any future KAL presentation
rescue_or_adjustment_to_test: Test Pagat's sourced reverse variant where the odd-card holder wins and a smaller rank set; do not claim reduced frustration without observation
architecture_verdict: Candidate: strong matching and suspense hook; publish only with an observed low-friction framing
evidence_classification: Setup, rules, players, publisher age, and reverse variant are SOURCE_BACKED; framing and architecture are EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT; KAL outcomes are UNKNOWN

canonical_setup: Standard 52-card deck; Bicycle deals 5 cards each; stock and starter piles
core_loop: Match the starter by suit or rank; an eight is wild and names the next suit; first empty hand wins
rank_suit_load: Recognize ranks and four suits; remember wild-card choice
pace_or_contact: Turn-based; rule disagreements are plausible because many house variants exist
rule_variant_to_freeze: Freeze Bicycle's base game only: no extra skip, reverse, draw-two, stacking, or scoring rules
rescue_or_adjustment_to_test: Test a reduced deck and open-hand teaching round; keep one-card draw behavior explicit; do not publish an age-fit claim from the publisher label alone
architecture_verdict: Stretch candidate: greater agency and choice, but the highest rule and suit load in the five-game pack
evidence_classification: Base rules, players, publisher age, and variant prevalence are SOURCE_BACKED; rescue and architecture are EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT; KAL outcomes are UNKNOWN

canonical_setup: Standard 52-card deck divided into two face-down stacks of 26
core_loop: Reveal simultaneously; higher rank wins the cards; ties trigger another face-down and face-up comparison
rank_suit_load: Compare rank order; suits do not matter
pace_or_contact: Simultaneous reveal; full-deck game can run for a long time
rule_variant_to_freeze: Use Bicycle's one-face-down tie rule for canonical rules; do not mix in the common three-card tie rule
rescue_or_adjustment_to_test: Test Pagat's finite 32-card one-pass variation or a fixed number of rounds and count captured cards; label it as a short-form variant
architecture_verdict: Lead candidate only in finite form: immediate reveal hook and low rule load, but the canonical end condition is poor parent utility
evidence_classification: Base rules, players, publisher age, long-duration risk, and finite variation are SOURCE_BACKED; pack placement is EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT; KAL outcomes are UNKNOWN

canonical_setup: Standard 52-card deck dealt into face-down stacks; players reveal to face-up piles and call when top ranks match
core_loop: Reveal in turn; notice matching ranks; first valid call wins matching piles
rank_suit_load: Recognize ranks; suits do not matter
pace_or_contact: Fast visual race; simultaneous calls and dispute rules are part of the game; physical slapping is an optional variation, not required
rule_variant_to_freeze: If tested, freeze Pagat's standard separate-pile spoken-call version and explicitly exclude physical slapping
rescue_or_adjustment_to_test: Test the sourced single-pile spoken-call variation with no hand contact and a finite deck; do not claim it prevents conflict
architecture_verdict: Defer from the first pack: good high-energy hook but unresolved speed, fairness, and dispute fit
evidence_classification: Base rules, players, publisher age, and variants are SOURCE_BACKED; deferral and proposed test are EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT; KAL outcomes are UNKNOWN

canonical_setup: Standard 52-card deck spread face down; turn two cards and collect equal-rank pairs
core_loop: Choose two positions; keep equal-rank pairs and continue; otherwise restore them and pass the turn
rank_suit_load: Match ranks and remember positions; suits do not determine a pair in Bicycle rules
pace_or_contact: Calm turn-based play; a full 52-card layout has high space and memory load
rule_variant_to_freeze: Use Bicycle's equal-rank pair rule; future KAL diagrams must show the exact chosen small-deck layout
rescue_or_adjustment_to_test: Test a 12-card grid made from two suits and ranks ace through six; this is an editorial combination of source-backed challenge-reduction patterns
architecture_verdict: Lead candidate: distinct hidden-pair discovery hook and the most adjustable setup, pending real layout testing
evidence_classification: Base rules, players, and publisher age are SOURCE_BACKED; reduced-grid design and architecture are EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT; KAL outcomes are UNKNOWN

canonical_setup: Standard 52-card deck dealt into face-down stacks; reveal to one center pile; first hand on a jack wins the pile
core_loop: Reveal in turn and physically slap a jack; incorrect slaps carry a card penalty
rank_suit_load: Recognize jacks; other ranks do not drive the basic trigger
pace_or_contact: Fast physical hand contact over a shared pile; disputes and mistaken-slap penalties are explicit
rule_variant_to_freeze: Use Bicycle's jack-only rule for research comparison; do not silently turn it into Snap or Irish Snap
rescue_or_adjustment_to_test: No public KAL version should be selected until a family test evaluates contact, mistaken slaps, stopping, and a possible spoken-call substitute
architecture_verdict: Defer: the contact and dispute structure needs direct family evidence before it belongs in a young-child starter pack
evidence_classification: Base rules, players, publisher age, and contact/dispute mechanics are SOURCE_BACKED; deferral is EDITORIAL_JUDGMENT; KAL outcomes are UNKNOWN
